claim_updates.reason: Bounded advance from EXPERIMENTAL (research/claims/registry.json C-MEAS-VALID) on an independent audit with status=PASS and producer_claim_supported=true, which is the frozen precondition for VALIDATED. The registry next_gate for this claim is 'writable/auth/session/drift controls must produce discriminating positive and null outcomes'; the frozen primary estimand (spec.json decision_rule.primary_estimand) measured exactly that, arm-constrained, and every arm met both thresholds with a non-degenerate interval. Producer result.json metrics.part_A_arm_metrics and audit.json recomputed_metrics.part_A_arm_metrics agree exactly: P-WRITE sensitivity k=20/20 point=1.0 Wilson95 [0.8388748419471806, 1.0]; P-DRIFT sensitivity k=20/20 point=1.0 same interval; N-READ, N-INVALID, N-EXPIRED and N-DELETED specificity k=20/20 point=1.0 same interval each; frozen gates point>=0.90 and wilson_lo>=0.80 with ci_hi>ci_lo. Validity is grounded in raw evidence, not in the producer's control packaging: artifacts/A-CAPTURE-STABILITY.jsonl gives 10/10 byte-identical no-action WAL-vector pairs; artifacts/A-WAL-VECTOR-BEFORE-AFTER.jsonl shows the pre/post vector SHA-256 changing in every positive episode and being byte-identical in every null episode; artifacts/A-EPISODE-LEDGER.jsonl records 120 episodes with action_exception None, statuses 200/200/200/401/401/403 for P-WRITE/P-DRIFT/N-READ/N-INVALID/N-EXPIRED/N-DELETED and 0 auth-boundary violations; artifacts/A-RECOMPUTE-CHECK.json is an independent re-implementation reading only raw JSONL with zero_mismatches=true; the arm label is joined only after A-DETECTOR-OUTPUT.jsonl is written, and the seeded order is archived in artifacts/A-SEEDED-ORDER.json. EXACT BOUND OF THIS VALIDATION, which must travel with the status: the validated object is the measurement instrument, namely the composite oracle (length-framed SHA-256 over /tmp/single.db plus /tmp/single.db-wal, the SQL logical projection of the controlled row, and the stable-header response fingerprint) and its ability to separate two planted positive interventions (valid-auth marker write, valid-auth induced representation drift) from four matched nulls (read-only, invalid-auth, expired-auth, deleted-session), each over 20 episodes, on the exact fixture of 2x gunicorn 23.0.0 at 127.0.0.1:19860/19861 sharing the /tmp/single.db SQLite WAL with wal_autocheckpoint=0 behind exclusive nginx 1.24.0 at 19851 with a single 'hash $request_uri consistent' upstream, real proxy_cache, authorization bypass and X-Worker-Pid, over plain HTTP on localhost. The validated scope explicitly EXCLUDES browser transport, TLS, HTTP/2, multi-host, real-site behaviour, any downstream lane's own measurement surface, and any statement about a shared program component: the intervention surface, the auth/session boundary, the routes and the schema are authored inside this packet's own harness (run_experiment.py:237 create_app, :400 _authenticate, :438 POST /runtime/write, :353 and :357 the /api/profile and /api/data_list routes), so the ground-truth provider and the detector share an author. This is why the status is a bounded instrument validation and not a component or product validation. TWO DEFECTS ADJUDICATED AND NOT TREATED AS FALSIFICATION: (1) result.json controls.V-SUBSTRATE-CERTIFICATE reports pass=false with observed='{}' while the control's own named evidence, artifacts/A-READINESS-CERTIFICATE.json, records pass=true with n_total=850, n_non304=850 (floor 800), per_ep_non304 425/425 (floor 400 each), n_distinct_x_worker_pid=2 (floor 2), min_per_uri_stickiness=1.0 over 12 URIs (floor 0.90 over >10), n_missing_worker_on_200=0, and a real proxy_cache MISS-then-HIT corroboration. The Director read that raw artifact and adopts the auditor's PASS; the same floors are independently re-probed by a different program in artifacts/capability_ledger.json components CAP-N-NON304-FLOOR and CAP-X-WORKER-PID-FLOOR. This is a serialization defect in the control record, not a substrate failure, and it is the same class of defect as the Codex-recorded non-discriminating-control instances. (2) Part B=UNAVAILABLE is caused by NameError: name 'pre_null_logical' is not defined at run_experiment.py:1444 inside the four-nulls loop, where pre_null_vec and post_null_logical are captured but pre_null_logical is never assigned; this aborted execution before artifacts/B-WAL-EVIDENCE.jsonl was written at run_experiment.py:1482. It is a harness defect, and by the frozen precedence rule (spec.json decision_rule.precedence) B failure never changes A. Browser capability itself is positively established in this run: artifacts/B-PLAYWRIGHT-CAPABILITY.json records public_api_only=true, private_helper_used=false, synthetic_fallback_used=false, p.chromium.executable_path resolving to /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome (sha256 8c599d43aec53f2460a31ae2f4af6bd863f8258b34ff519564bc5d4726bfaa1e) and a real launch of browser_version 153.0.8010.12 at viewport_actual 1280x720, with artifacts/B-DOM-AX-CAPTURE.json recording page_content 2385 bytes, 28 CDP DOM snapshot nodes via DOM.getDocument(depth=-1,pierce=True) and 30 Accessibility.getFullAXTree nodes. NOT PROMOTED, NOT EXTENDED: the claim is not PRODUCT_CORE and the Director emits no SHIPPED status; Part C and durability are contract results, not claim advances, and no new claim is created here.

product_action: No product action and no promotion. This is a runtime-lane measurement instrument result; product promotion is authorized only for Product-lane code that passed its own frozen gate and audit, and this packet is neither. The one genuinely reusable artifact is the one-command fail-closed capability contract in research/runtime/bringup.py plus research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-36129163700/bringup_contract.json, which exits 0 with 'all declared required scopes pass' (artifacts/C-BRINGUP-CONTRACT.json) and emits a 12-component machine-readable ledger with per-scope required-versus-advisory classification (artifacts/capability_ledger.json). Downstream lanes may preregister it as a precondition and fail closed on it, with two constraints recorded in the handoff: it requires a live 2x gunicorn plus exclusive-nginx substrate, so it is not a stateless capability check, and its Part-C availability does not certify the browser write path, whose only remaining untested link is the valid-auth SPA interaction. Do not advertise any part of this packet as shipping substrate, and do not treat the ledger's advisory components (browsergym, agentlab, policy-model credential, GHCR) as available: all four probed UNAVAILABLE in this run.
next_question: Now that the WAL-byte plus logical-projection plus response-fingerprint intervention oracle is VALIDATED against a planted surface, does that same oracle still reach arm-constrained point sensitivity and specificity >=0.90 with two-sided 95% Wilson lower bound >=0.80 and non-degenerate intervals when BOTH bounding confounds of the current scope are broken at once: (i) authorship, by implementing the intervention surface and its auth/session boundary in a module separate from the scorer so the detector never shares an author with the ground-truth provider, and (ii) transport, by driving the full valid-auth SPA write, reversible restore, and the read-only, invalid-auth, expired-auth and deleted-session nulls through the already-demonstrated public-API Chromium path (p.chromium.executable_path launch of /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome, Chromium 153.0.8010.12, real 1280x720 CDP DOM plus Accessibility.getFullAXTree) instead of the plain-HTTP client path, with the run_experiment.py:1444 pre_null_logical NameError repaired before freeze, real button clicks as the only write mechanism, mandatory before/after WAL byte evidence, and no synthetic fallback - i.e. does the measurement instrument generalize across the author/measurer boundary and the transport boundary simultaneously, which is the single untested step between this bounded VALIDATED scope and any downstream lane preregistering it as a precondition?
reason: Decision grounded in the frozen transaction and the independent audit, not in restated confidence. Producer transaction was valid: result.json status=COMPLETE with outcome=SUPPORTS, 120 of 120 episodes scored, no exceptions, no imputation, and provenance.json recording base_sha 8bc01342a23fe7a24959d09d8e2556ba2966c7e8, head_sha ebb9db201c50b8473814b4404e78ec3a43c70fe2, python 3.12.14, flask 3.1.3, pyjwt 2.15.0, gunicorn 23.0.0, nginx 1.24.0, playwright 1.63.0, seed 36129163700, matching the frozen freeze.json hashes. Independent audit status=PASS with producer_claim_supported=true, which satisfies the only stated precondition for VALIDATED, and the auditor's own claim_ceiling states H1-A-INTERVENTION-VALIDITY is supported in the exact bounded setting and that this packet authorizes no registry promotion - that reservation is the producer/auditor stages declining to self-promote, not a bar to the Director stage, since prereg.md:43 and spec.json decision_rule.top_level_result_mapping reserve promotion to a later independent Director verdict. The scientific advance is real and it repairs a scope error in the record: C-MEAS-VALID had been driven to EXPERIMENTAL and then MEASUREMENT_INVALID by packets whose browser provisioning failed, even though the plain-HTTP scope had passed; this packet finally measured the registry's own next_gate on the non-vetoing part and produced a complete, recomputed, arm-constrained result. I bound the advance to the instrument and to this fixture, because the intervention surface, auth boundary, routes and schema are authored in the same file as the scorer, so author and measurer are not independent; and I explicitly did not let the two outstanding defects become negative results. First, V-SUBSTRATE-CERTIFICATE reports pass=false in result.json with an empty observed object, but the artifact that control names as its evidence records pass=true with all five frozen floors satisfied, corroborated by two separately probed ledger components; the frozen rule requires the validity controls to pass and they do pass on the raw record, so this is a packaging defect, not a failed gate, and the auditor required the fix for future runs. Second, Part B=UNAVAILABLE is a NameError at run_experiment.py:1444 that aborted after the in-process SPA write click and before the WAL evidence file was written at :1482, so the browser write, restore and null outcomes are untested and their in-process execution is not durable evidence; under the frozen precedence that cannot touch Part A, and the audit confirmed the precedence was honored. Critically, this inverts the provisioning story the two preceding Runtime packets died on: the private-helper requirement was the only thing that ever blocked the browser here, and the public Playwright 1.63.0 API launches the canonical Chromium and yields real DOM and AX captures. The Codex contradiction is also resolved at component level by same-run probes rather than by erasure: Playwright and the Chromium launch are AVAILABLE while browsergym and agentlab imports both fail with ModuleNotFoundError, all four credential env keys are absent, HF returns HTTP 200 in 78.7 ms and GHCR returns HTTP 401. That means the two probes were not lying about each other, they were measuring different environments, and any lane needing browsergym or agentlab is blocked in this environment. Durability is reported UNSATISFIABLE and I keep it: the three frozen-scope paths were absent from HEAD at the measurement head ebb9db20, which the Director verified directly. Two further corrections the record needs, neither of which changes the decision: D-DURABILITY-CHECK.json asserts worktree_exists=false for all three paths, which is factually false for all three (run_experiment.py was the executing harness, bringup.py was invoked one second before the check, and bringup_contract.json is hash-recorded in freeze.json), so only its head_exists=false fields and the resulting UNSATISFIABLE disposition are trustworthy; and after the packet the workflow's own EXECUTE and AUDIT stage commits placed all three paths at the current HEAD de51ddacf67f9cb9d05804584b306db96c575d2b with content hashes byte-equal to the measured files, so the durability repair has since occurred by authorized commit and no durability re-experiment is needed. I set continue=false because the next question is a NEW governed experiment that changes both authorship and transport, which the Global Research Director must authorize with a director_mandate; a local lane Director adjudicates evidence and does not dispatch. I set promote_to_product=false because the lane is runtime, the audit is not a product gate, and the ledger's availability says nothing about shipping readiness.
